content.short: Krystal is a feature-rich Web3 wallet offering portfolio management, P&L tracking, multi-chain swaps, and DeFi tools for Mantle users.
content.description: Krystal is a Web3 wallet and portfolio management platform designed to give users complete visibility and control over their on-chain assets. The wallet features comprehensive portfolio tracking with profit-and-loss analysis, built-in token swaps aggregated from multiple DEXes for best rates, cross-chain bridging, and a Web3 browser for interacting with dApps. Advanced security tools include transaction simulation to preview outcomes before signing. Krystal fully supports Mantle Network and offers a polished experience for managing Mantle DeFi positions.
